notes.title: Update: New Content Added to Prisoner of Destiny!
notes.content:
Hi,

We’ve just added a big content update to our expansion, Prisoner of Destiny! This update includes a new epilogue path, new romances, a new transformation, and more. We have used some of the suggestions from the discussion forums in creating this content. Thanks so much for your support and your patience.

Also, stay tuned for a special announcement next week!

[b]Update Feature List (Spoilers Below!):[/b]

[spoiler]Content:
[list]
[*] One new epilogue path
[*] Two new romance pictures (1 at the end of the new path, 1 at the end of the Darious path)
[*] One new transformation, included in the new path
[*] One new mini scene (at the end of the Brock path)
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Mila vanished during skip mode
[*] Fixed an issue where two music tracks would sometimes overlap during skip mode
[*] Fixed a few typos
[/list]
[/spoiler]
